name: Distributed Training at Scale: DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed and Megatron
description: A practitioner's course on how large-model training is actually distributed: data parallelism and sharding (DDP, ZeRO, FSDP2), tensor, pipeline, context and expert parallelism, how to combine them, and how to launch, checkpoint, measure and debug the result on a real cluster.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Distributed Training at Scale: DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed and Megatron

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 60 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
